title: merge-agent project config
description: Schema for .merge-agent.json at the repo root.

disabled.description: Kill switch. When true, /cma:merge exits 0 immediately without touching git. The CMA_DISABLE=1 env var has the same effect at invocation time and overrides this field.

command.description: Shell command run as the canonical gate. Exit 0 = green, anything else = red.

runOn.description: Where to run the gate. v0.1 supports only "local"; ssh/container land in v0.2.

timeoutSeconds.description: Kill the gate after this many seconds. Default 15 minutes.

file.description: Path (relative to repo root) of the ratchet baseline file. Required if ratchet is configured.

lockCommand.description: Shell command that re-locks the ratchet file when current counts improve. Run after a green gate.

commitMessage.description: Commit message for the auto-committed ratchet update.

mode.description: How the rebased branch lands on main. "direct-push" (default) runs git push origin HEAD:main. "merge-queue" opens a PR and submits to GitHub Merge Queue via the gh CLI — required when branch protection on main demands a PR.

ghmq.description: Merge-queue tuning, only used when mode="merge-queue".

pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to poll the queued PR's state.

timeoutSeconds.description: Give up waiting for the queue to merge the PR after this many seconds.

dashboard.description: Optional override for the cma web dashboard URL.

url.description: Base URL of the dashboard. Defaults to the hosted instance (cma-dashboard-eight.vercel.app).

branchProtection.description: Behaviour of the SessionStart hook when main has no branch protection.

lockFile.description: Path (relative to repo root) of the merge-agent lock directory.

lockTtlSeconds.description: Lock is considered stale after this many seconds (allows recovery from crashed mergers).
